query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nicheId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_niche,
  SUM(CASE WHEN nicheId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_niche
FROM companies;

SELECT id, name, companyCount, 
  CASE WHEN companyIds IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_ids' ELSE 'no_ids' END as has_company_ids,
  fitScore
FROM niches 
ORDER BY fitScore DESC 
LIMIT 10;
